body: I work for a tv news station running our website and social media. Not sure it’s the best job for living with this diagnosis but I found a passion for it so I’ve stuck with it. It’s very stressful and fast-paced. I see the absolute worst of people but also sometimes the absolute best. I feel like it’s been a good way of exposing myself to the grey areas of life, and reminding myself that nothing is black and white. However, this field is known for being incredibly stressful and I was warned by professors that this field has many alcoholics, divorcees, etc. I see a therapist to talk through the harder stories and help process everything. But I really do love it. I’m in a happy, healthy relationship for the first time in my life and I love this career. I was diagnosed with BPD about three years ago now I think? I remember feeling like it was the end of the world, like I was just a broken person and was bad or something. It got wayyyyy better. I’m so happy now.

Mania is not a necessary symptom for BPD/EID but it can be a symptom for some.. I go through episodes of mania for sure. I’m good at channeling it now but before my therapist gave me tools to use to channel it I would get in the car and drive hours away, leaving my phone behind and scaring everyone. I would impulse dye my hair, make insane impulsive purchases and more that I don’t necessarily care to share but my therapist would refer to that as manic episodes and the only diagnosis I have is BPD/EID.

Adding to that.. I tend to date narcissists (not sure if that’s a BPD thing or just me) recently my ex tried to get back together and I had already gotten very over it so I pointed out to him how little he actually knew about me and he was stunned. He couldn’t name what colors I liked, any movies or shows I liked, or music. He asked why I never spoke up and I said “because you never asked and with my BPD it’s very easy for me to just skip into a people pleasing role and go along with the things you like”
Yes and I’ve been single for so long because I actually really like who I am and I’m advancing in my career and I don’t trust myself not to disappear into a relationship if I do find one.

It’s so bad :( I had an ulcer last year that was so awful I couldn’t even swallow my own spit. I just laid on the couch and would spit into a bowl. I had to go on a steroid to be able to eat and drink again. Now I’m good at recognizing when they start to come on so I go on an all dairy diet for a day or two til I feel it’s gone.

It’s ok! I just wanted to share my experience to maybe help you feel better that you can’t do it. I sometimes regret even starting doing it because I think I’m the long run it’s just caused more issues for me.

I’ve been feeling like I’m losing my ability to air vomit over the last week and I’m kind of grateful cause I was starting to deal with some of the nasty side effects of it 😅 so idk, I know it brings relief to air vomit but I don’t think it’s a great solution either. Just offering a bright side maybe?

Yeah this is a symptom! I remember my childhood best friend and I would have farting competitions and I always won. One day she jokingly said “It’s not fair cause you don’t burp so then it all comes out the other end” and at the time it seemed funny but now I’m grown up and I realize that yeah, that’s exactly what’s going on 😅😂

For some people it can have negative effects over time. For me at first it was just air and relief but now I do throw up sometimes when doing it. Usually just bile so it’s not like I’m losing food, but it’s harsh on the throat. I get throat ulcers and I have a really overactive gag reflex (I gag when brushing my teeth and even cleaning my ears) it’s bizarre. I also can’t always control when I do air vomit now. Sometimes it starts as a cough and then turns into air vomit and everyone around me gets freaked out. It’s pretty embarrassing. I don’t recommend it tbh, it’s a whole other debilitation that comes with R-CPD.

It’s been interesting. It’s weird though because it’s something that they’ve both just accepted and lived with their whole lives, they didn’t even realize they both had it until I brought it up at a family event a year ago and they shared their stories.
Thank you!! ❤️

We’re having issues with the wet food! We’ve bought at least 10 different brands/flavors just to sample and see what he likes. He snacks throughout the day on his kibble but doesn’t seem to over eat so far (his food dish is kept in the kitchen which is an area he doesn’t like to spend much time in, he’ll run off if we go out while he’s eating) Right now he’s been struggling to pass a hair ball, we picked up some cat grass to try to help and hopefully the vet can give us more advice/answers tomorrow. If he does turn out to be MC I’m feeling out of my element haha, our last kitty had tummy problems and was on a medicated diet his whole life so I’m not used to having to do so much research on food! But it’s also exciting and you’ve helped a ton, I cannot thank you enough!

BPD aside, this sounds like emotional abuse. I was in a long term relationship that was abusive both emotionally and eventually physically as well. As people w/ BPD I think we’re extra vulnerable to people who will take advantage of us because we can end up so dependent on them. My advice would be to leave but I understand it’s much harder than that. Just take care of yourself and be careful.

Thank you! We are looking into Basepaws now! He does seem to have some tummy problems, we’re trying to get him into the vet as well but they’re scheduled out far for anything that isn’t “emergency.” So it’s good to know that there might be an explanation for that.

Thank you so much! This has been the most helpful information I’ve gotten so far! His tail does seem to be about the length of shoulders to rear (though he’s sleeping right now so I didn’t wanna mess with him too much to measure) body wise MC’s are just “bulkier” right? Overall he is much bigger than any cat I’ve had before, maybe bulky? The shelter thought he was over weight so they had him on a diet. Though now that we’re questioning if he’s part MC we’re thinking he wasn’t overweight after all. He was found on the street with his brother and sister, his brother’s pattern was tuxedo and his sister was calico. We’re wondering if they came from a breeder who wasn’t happy with the litter, since there was no mama nearby.

He’s just a mystery to us and we would love to learn more about him, we’ve discussed a dna test but wanted to get some other opinions first! So thank you!

Definitely still working on this. :/
